entries.name: Orianna
entries.why: Shockwave enables team engage; command synergies scale with coordination

entries.name: Malphite
entries.why: Unstoppable Impulse is a free teamfight; 100% reliable in premades

entries.name: Amumu
entries.why: Bandage Toss + Curse of the Sad Mummy = instant teamfight win with follow-up

entries.name: Shen
entries.why: Global presence; Stand United coordination is near-impossible in solo but free in Clash

entries.name: Jarvan IV
entries.why: Cataclysm + coordinated follow-up catches enemies perfectly; strong objective control

entries.name: Lulu
entries.why: Hyper carries scale massively with Lulu; Wild Growth synergy is voice-comms dependent

entries.name: Jinx
entries.why: Snowball potential; Get Excited resets turn solo kills into multi-kills with coordination

entries.name: Zac
entries.why: Long-range engage; Let's Bounce is devastating with follow-up from comms

entries.name: Thresh
entries.why: Flay + Death Sentence creates picks; lantern is wasted in solo but free in Clash

entries.name: Azir
entries.why: Emperor's Divide peels perfectly for your carry; hard to execute alone

entries.name: Braum
entries.why: Passive setup requires coordination; Glacial Fissure with CC chain = gg

entries.name: Jhin
entries.why: Curtain Call + engage partner is deadly; roots chain with comms

entries.name: Rumble
entries.why: Equalizer mid-teamfight with voice = free kills; peel or initiate flex

entries.name: Sejuani
entries.why: Glacial Prison from off-screen; Permafrost with ADC = braindead CC chain

entries.name: Galio
entries.why: Hero's Entrance = global follow-up; completely changes teamfight geometry

entries.name: Leona
entries.why: Lock-down chains are telegraphed in solo; lethal with coordinated follow-up

entries.name: Sivir
entries.why: On The Hunt gives entire team move speed for coordinated engage or disengage

entries.name: Kassadin
entries.why: Late-game hypercarry that teams can protect to 16; doable in premade

entries.name: Caitlyn
entries.why: Safe laning + Ace in the Hole coordination; objective focus is premade-friendly

entries.name: Nautilus
entries.why: Reliable engage but telegraphed; best with dive comps

entries.name: Vi
entries.why: Cease and Desist targets high-priority; teamfight pathing benefits from comms

entries.name: Camille
entries.why: Hextech Ultimatum isolates carries; less powerful if enemy has disengage

entries.name: Lucian
entries.why: Lightslinger combos with support; needs specific synergies to pop off

entries.name: Gnar
entries.why: Mega Gnar timing with team is clutch; communication required for max value

entries.name: Taliyah
entries.why: Weaver's Wall cuts off escapes with comms; roam timing benefits from voice

entries.name: Ashe
entries.why: Hawkshot + Enchanted Crystal Arrow coordination across map; utility carry

entries.name: Rell
entries.why: Magnet Storm in dive comp is huge; clunky solo but coordinated pairs well

entries.name: Yasuo
entries.why: Needs knock-up partner; high mechanical floor means high-risk in Clash

entries.name: Tryndamere
entries.why: Split-push menace but teams often don't follow-up properly on pressure

entries.name: Zed
entries.why: Strong in solo but assassin identity undercuts teamfight compositions

entries.name: Vayne
entries.why: Mechanically demanding; outscaled in teamfights by coordinated engage

entries.name: Katarina
entries.why: CC-heavy compositions shut her down; enemies respect resets in premade

entries.name: Nunu
entries.why: Absolute Zero needs enemies to stand still; premades always disengage

entries.name: Yuumi
entries.why: Attach mechanic is abusable by enemies who collapse your carry; unreliable
